contract_name: JARVIS OS — Phase 40 Autonomous Engineering Loop Contract

cycle_stages.description: Deterministic capture of workspace, DAG, requirements, evidence, and prediction state.
Read-only predictive impact projection without side-effects.
Evaluation of current DAG plan validity or adaptation requirement.
Mission Gate verification of pending actions, security, and economic rules.
Swarm lifecycle task execution and agent assignment.
Empirical observation ingestion (AST, build, tests, browser QA, evidence).
PredictionComparator evaluation of predicted vs actual outcomes.
Deterministic policy evaluation producing structured decision and causal chain.
Application of gated adaptation proposals (repair, replan, reassign, task mutation).
Verification of requirement retention, drift limits, and state consistency.
Idempotent state checkpointing and WebSocket event publishing.
Advancement to next iteration or termination via Finish Gate.
